title: How to Contact AliExpress
description: Having trouble with AliExpress? Looking to get in contact with their customer service department? Watch this short tutorial video to learn how to contact AliExpress customer service.  Do you learn better by reading? A text version is available at: https://techboomers.com/t/contact-aliexpress-customer-service  Visit http://www.techboomers.com for over 100 free courses on all of today's most popular websites & apps!

asr.full_text: Need some help with AliExpress? We'll show you how to get in touch with them. I'm Jessica from techboomers.com. In this video, i'll show you how to contact AliExpress Customer Service. Now let's get started! First open your web browser and go to aliexpress com, and at the top of the page, click Help. Then, click Customer Service. From the menu on the left, click on the category that your question relates to. Then, choose from the subcategories that appear below it. Select one of the questions on the right. When you click on one of those questions, it will open a page or link that will point you in the right direction. If that doesn't solve your problem, you can talk to an Aliexpress customer service representative. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click CHAT NOW. A new window will open. Click in the text box at the bottom of the page and type in your question. When you are ready to send your message, click Send. When you're finished chatting with AliExpress customer service, click End Service. That's all there is to contacting AliExpress customer service. If you're interested in trying some alternatives to AliExpress, check out our Sites Like AliExpress article on TechBoomers.com. Thanks for watching! If you found this video helpful, we'd love it if you'd click the thumbs up button below. Check out TechBoomers.com for over 100 free courses on all of today's most popular websites and apps
